extras: Free service with no daily cap and no watermarks, but API runs are subject to the paid plan's speed allowance.
problem: Users need a way to transform static images or text descriptions into dynamic, sound-enabled video content directly within their notes.

relations.evidence: Sign in on freeimagetovideo.ai and create a key at freeimagetovideo.ai/settings/apikeys.

summary: AI tool that converts vault images or text prompts into sound-enabled video clips, which are then saved and embedded directly into the Obsidian note.
